verified_reproduction.method: Imported exact user-supplied module, mocked only the external coverage-QA dependency; created disposable synthetic Premiere XML for injection test. Did not touch production.
results: Two 0.10 score detections of a stationary microphone-like marker separated by 0.067 sec are accepted as SHORT_STABLE, yielding three localized intervals.
Single detection with score 0.35 is accepted as STRONG_HIT.
inject_cigarette_blur mutates its target XML file despite provided detection_report.passed=false; returns QA FAIL only after XML is written.

findings.issue: track confirmation is purely geometric, class string can be wrong; normal, short-stable or strong-hit detections can become accepted without independent cigarette semantic identity
Premiere XML is written before structural and coverage QA; failed semantic detector input can still overwrite the XML
empty source ranges return passed:true, despite having scanned no video
report passed logic accepts at least one confirmed track even if other raw detections remain unconfirmed; zero detector detections also yield passed true regardless of full-frame recall evidence
QA checks only filter presence, overlay count and duration; this does not certify blur subject, framing, motion or complete video coverage
padded boxes and time interpolation blur a rectangular region, cannot prove cigarette-only segmentation under occlusion
earlier cigarette tracks are removed on retry before semantic validation has passed; combined with early writing may lose previously correct effects

requirements_before_production_promotion: Independent semantic identity verifier on actual video frames, not YOLOWorld class name, confidence, stable center, or IoU alone.
Consecutive object-level evidence and explicit microphone-mark negative regression without any blanket spatial ban near microphone.
Object mask or tightly localized verified region and motion/occlusion handling; no whole-frame blur.
Verified frame coverage of the entire retained dialogue, even if the detector reports zero cigarettes.
Reject ambiguous, unsupported or unverified candidate tracks; fail closed to manual review rather than auto-publish.
Perform all XML changes on a staged temporary file; structural, semantic and per-frame video QA before atomic publication.
Preserve byte-identical audio and unrelated tracks; never auto-release 886_5 without full independent verification.

shadow_candidate.behavior: Rejects all XML injection until independently verified cigarette identity is integrated; deny zero source ranges; mark scan results as unverified candidates. This is a deliberate safe test and NOT a complete production detector.
shadow_candidate.test_result: 3 attempted injections rejected with XML byte preservation; original uploaded module byte preserved.
